Which games are coming to PS Plus next?

A note on accuracy: these are educated guesses, not inside information. The model catches a fair share of each month's additions but misses plenty, and the game details it learns from, like publishers and release dates, come from Wikipedia and Wikidata and are sometimes wrong. We're always refining it and checking the data, so if you spot something off, let us know.

Every PS4 and PS5 game that isn't on PS Plus yet, ranked by how likely it is to join in the next three months. The odds come from a model trained on every lineup Sony has announced since PS Plus Extra launched in 2022, so treat this as a watchlist rather than a promise. Open any game to see how its chances change month by month.

Updated 22 November 2026. Chances are for the three months from December 2026.

How it works

For every month since PS Plus Extra launched (and since 2019 for the monthly games), each PS4 and PS5 game that could have been added is one example, and the games Sony actually added are the hits. The model learns how much each signal mattered. The bars show how strongly each one pushes a game up or down.

Rules and limits
  • The year's biggest launches are held back: nothing anywhere near as big as GTA VI has ever joined in its first year, so those wait until the year is up.
  • Free-to-play games are left out, since they don't need PS Plus.
  • Popularity is how often the game's Wikipedia article was read in the last 60 days: a good guide to interest today, but not to how big a game was at launch.
  • Deals between Sony and publishers are invisible to the model, so surprise launch-day indies will always catch it out.
  • Games without a Wikipedia or Wikidata entry are missing, or the model knows less about them.

Sources: Wikidata and Wikipedia (CC BY-SA) for games, publishers, release dates and page views; the PlayStation Blog for past lineups.
